title: Prospective Context-Coordinate Discriminator Construction, Exact Matched-(G,E) Compatibility/Coexistence/Authority Separation, Orthogonal Context Intervention, Coordinate Dependency Graph Recovery, Minimal-Context Equivalence-Class Replication, Cross-Domain Identifiability Transport & the Court of Whether X Has Stable Primitive Structure

prospective_discriminator_rules.exact_matched_GE: Primary identification requires pairs or small sets with materially equivalent G and E under frozen normalization.
prospective_discriminator_rules.orthogonality: A candidate coordinate is promoted only when its variation is not bundled with another candidate coordinate across the decisive contrast.
prospective_discriminator_rules.replication: At least two distinct domains must reproduce the same coordinate-to-action discrimination before stable primitive status.
prospective_discriminator_rules.negative_control: At least one matched case must show that changing a non-target coordinate alone does not spuriously reproduce the target effect.
prospective_discriminator_rules.representation_invariance: Coordinate discrimination must survive alternate encoding and naming.
prospective_discriminator_rules.anti_rationalization: No new primitive X coordinate may be introduced after a failed discriminator inside the same Court.

COMPATIBILITY_OBLIGATION.predicted_discriminator: Same G,E and lifecycle/authority/coexistence, differing obligation to preserve old consumer behavior changes bridge/removal action.

COEXISTENCE_REQUIREMENT.predicted_discriminator: Same G,E and compatibility/authority/lifecycle, differing simultaneous old/new operation changes coexistence-vs-replacement action.

RELEASE_AUTHORITY.predicted_discriminator: Same G,E and compatibility/coexistence/lifecycle, differing actor or release authority changes what mutation is permissible.

dependency_graph_rules.edge_A_to_B: A -> B only if A operationally constrains or deterministically derives B under frozen rules.
dependency_graph_rules.merge: Coordinates with reciprocal derivability or inseparability across all admitted discriminator families merge into one equivalence class.
dependency_graph_rules.primitive: A primitive coordinate must have at least one discriminator that survives conditioning on other retained coordinates.
dependency_graph_rules.nonprimitive: A coordinate is nonprimitive if derivable, always bundled, or relocatable to G/E without information loss.

r2_gate: LAW-R2 remains unauthorized unless fresh normalized same-(X,G,E) conflicting action survives all P13 discriminator/dependency reconstruction.
